decisions.reason: The hearty bread rests on the firm's core baking knowledge, so it can read sales and adjust the recipe in-house, though it has not been observed since 2019 and some assortment rotation is likely.
The mill tour uses the firm's heritage and event facilities, but tour demand after the pandemic is harder for a bakery to interpret and improve than baked goods, which raises the risk it is dropped.
The sweet pastry fits squarely within the firm's confectionery expertise and can be refined from customer feedback, though pastry ranges rotate often.
The farmhouse bread is a natural extension of the firm's bread craft, so it can absorb feedback and keep the product competitive without outside R&D.
The poppy seed stollen won a gold award, is presented as a flagship, and builds on the firm's traditional stollen recipes, so it is a validated product the firm understands well.
The premium stollen also won a gold award and draws on deep seasonal baking expertise, which makes it a reliable festive and gift item worth keeping.
